worked_solution: Garden A perimeter: 8 + 3 + 8 + 3 = 22 m. Garden B perimeter: 6 + 5 + 6 + 5 = 22 m.

prompt_latex: \text{A triangle has corners at (6, 2), (8, 2) and (6, 5). After one transformation the corners are at (2, 2), (4, 2) and (2, 5). The triangle was not flipped or turned. Name the transformation and describe the move.}
prompt_plain: A triangle has corners at (6, 2), (8, 2) and (6, 5). After one transformation the corners are at (2, 2), (4, 2) and (2, 5). The triangle was not flipped or turned. Name the transformation and describe the move.

prompt_parts.text: A triangle has corners at (6, 2), (8, 2) and (6, 5). After one transformation the corners are at (2, 2), (4, 2) and (2, 5). The triangle was not flipped or turned. Name the transformation and describe the move.

worked_solution: Compare each corner before and after: (6, 2) → (2, 2), (8, 2) → (4, 2), (6, 5) → (2, 5).
The up numbers did not change. Each across number went down by 4: 6 − 2 = 4 and 8 − 4 = 4.
The whole shape moved the same way with no flip or turn, so it is a slide (translation) 4 units left.

worked_solution: C is 4 − 2 = 2 units above the line.
Its image is 2 units below the line: 2 − 2 = 0.
